rows.instrumentTitle: قرار بقانون رقم (2) لسنة 2023م بتعديل قانون الأوقاف والشؤون والمقدسات الإسلامية رقم (26) لسنة 1966م وتعديلاته

evidence.proposition: Official registry marks the decree-law as in force and records an effective date of 2023-02-23.
A later official instruction concerning the Ibrahimi Mosque relies on the 2023 waqf amendment.

notes: Pilot verifies explicit registry status and a West Bank application signal; broader constitutional/territorial questions remain reviewable outside this row.

rows.instrumentTitle: قرار بقانون رقم (2) لسنة 2023م بتعديل قانون الأوقاف والشؤون والمقدسات الإسلامية رقم (26) لسنة 1966م وتعديلاته

evidence.proposition: The registry status of the instrument is official, but this evidence does not by itself resolve current Gaza applicability.

notes: No Gaza-specific current applicability conclusion is inferred from West Bank/central-government evidence.

rows.instrumentTitle: قانون الأوقاف والشؤون الدينية رقم (26) لسنة 1966م وتعديلاته

evidence.proposition: Official consolidated text lists the original law and its amendments through the 2023 decree-law.
Official West Bank instruction relies on the amended waqf legislation.

notes: The row identifies the law as amended, not as an untouched 1966 text.

rows.instrumentTitle: قانون تسوية الأراضي والمياه رقم (40) لسنة 1952م

evidence.proposition: Current Land Authority settlement guidance expressly operates by reference to Law No. 40 of 1952.
A 2025 official settlement notice invokes Article 6 of Law No. 40 of 1952.

notes: Current official application is verified, but a full amendment/repeal consolidation is still required before asserting a complete legal-status conclusion.

rows.instrumentTitle: مسار تشريعات الأراضي المعمول بها في قطاع غزة

evidence.proposition: Gaza-specific official guidance describes Egyptian-administration legislation and land-law layers relevant to government and waqf property.

notes: This row proves a separate Gaza legal track exists; it intentionally does not collapse that track into a single current statute.

rows.instrumentTitle: قرار بقانون رقم (6) لسنة 2010م بشأن سلطة الأراضي

evidence.proposition: Official legislation registry records the instrument as in force and records its effective date.
Current Palestinian Land Authority legal-framework material identifies the 2010 Land Authority decree-law among its governing sources.

notes: Pilot conclusion is limited to the status/applicability proposition evidenced here; it does not certify every subordinate rule issued under the law.

rows.instrumentTitle: قرار بقانون رقم (7) لسنة 2016م بشأن هيئة تسوية الأراضي والمياه

evidence.proposition: Official registry labels the instrument explicitly repealed.

notes: Repeal status is explicit in the official registry, while the complete repealing-chain and territorial transition remain expert-review items.

rows.instrumentTitle: قانون المالكين والمستأجرين رقم (62) لسنة 1953م وتعديلاته

evidence.proposition: Official consolidated text records the original law and later amendments including the 2022 Palestinian amendment.
Current Land Authority lease procedure refers to landlord/tenant rules for relevant transactions.

notes: General landlord/tenant law is kept distinct from the special waqf tenancy law.

rows.instrumentTitle: قانون المالكين والمستأجرين رقم (62) لسنة 1953م وتعديلاته

evidence.proposition: The official consolidated text establishes instrument identity and amendments but does not independently resolve current Gaza applicability.

notes: No West Bank operational evidence is imported into the Gaza row.

rows.instrumentTitle: قانون المالكين والمستأجرين للعقارات الوقفية رقم (5) لسنة 1964م

evidence.proposition: Trusted legal-reference portal reports the law as in force in the West Bank.

notes: Secondary in-force signal is useful for prioritization but cannot by itself unlock an authoritative status conclusion.

rows.instrumentTitle: قانون رقم (8) لسنة 1955م معدل لقانون تسوية الأراضي والمياه

evidence.proposition: Trusted legal-reference portal reports the amendment as in force in the West Bank.

notes: Requires authoritative consolidation/status evidence before a current-law conclusion.

evidence.proposition: Official consolidated text records the original expropriation law and subsequent amendments.
Trusted legal-reference portal reports current West Bank force as a secondary status signal.

notes: Official consolidation verifies amendment lineage, but secondary territorial status alone does not satisfy the territory gate.

evidence.proposition: The official text distinguishes underlying northern/West Bank registration-fee legislation.

notes: Territorial legal lineage is explicit, but present status remains unresolved until the current status/amendment chain is verified.
